home.hero_title: WE TRANSFORM TECHNICAL COMPLEXITY INTO STRATEGIC CLARITY.
home.hero_description: We specialize in process auditing, cybersecurity, and technical training for companies looking to protect their operations and optimize their workflows.
home.continuity_desc: Protocol design for organizational resilience against disasters.
home.who_we_are_desc: We are a technical consulting firm dedicated to raising the operational standards of the industrial, technological, and commercial sectors. We specialize in technical workflow optimization and operational risk mitigation.
home.who_we_are_desc2: Our work focuses on providing tools ranging from procedure manuals to data architectures that enable organizations to make decisions based on technical evidence rather than assumptions.
home.why_us_desc: Our differential value lies in technical precision and a focus on functional deliverables:
home.reason_1: Multidisciplinary Specialization: We cover everything from height safety (DC-3) to advanced cybersecurity audits.
home.reason_2: Continuity Focus: We design plans (BCP) so your company never stops due to earthquakes, floods, or IT failures.
home.reason_3: Proprietary Data Architecture: We deliver control dashboards where the client owns the architecture, eliminating dependence on external software rentals.
home.reason_4: Scientific Rigor: We conduct feasibility studies and usability tests (UX) with real users to guarantee the success of your points of sale and products.
home.audit_desc: Optimize your inventory control and detect shrinkage, operational errors, and risks in your processes. Our audit services analyze from 100 to 300 key SKUs to improve accuracy between physical inventory and system.
home.cyber_title: Evaluate the real security of your digital infrastructure
home.cyber_desc: We simulate controlled intrusion attempts to identify vulnerabilities in servers, networks, APIs, and internal accesses. Receive a detailed technical report and strategic recommendations to strengthen your organization's security.
home.feasibility_title: Evaluate the real potential of a location before investing
home.feasibility_desc: We analyze key factors such as pedestrian traffic, competition, population density, and socioeconomic profile to determine if an area is viable for your business. Our studies combine technical analysis and market data to support strategic decisions.
home.cta_title: Do you want to optimize your processes and reduce risks in your company?
home.cta_desc: Write to us to contact a specialist and discover how we can help you.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.dictamen_1_heading: Who is responsible for your data
privacy.dictamen_1_p1: ALTRUE BUSSINES CALL, S.A. de C.V. (hereinafter "the Controller") is the legal entity that determines the purposes and means of processing your personal data, in accordance with the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP).
privacy.dictamen_1_domicilio: Address: Av. Homero No. 203, Floor 8, Suite 804, Col. Polanco V Sección, Miguel Hidalgo Borough, C.P. 11560, Mexico City.
privacy.intro_p1: ALTRUE BUSSINES CALL, S.A. de C.V. audits processes, evaluates vulnerabilities, and structures data. We know that poorly managed information produces exactly the problems our clients hire us to solve. That is why we apply the same standard to our own data: no information is collected without purpose, none is retained without justification, none is shared without legal basis. This notice details it.
privacy.dictamen_2_heading: What data we collect and how
privacy.dictamen_2_p1: The Controller's website does not generate accounts, profiles, or access credentials. Personal data is obtained exclusively when the interested party voluntarily completes the contact form or service request form, or when a contractual relationship is formalized.
privacy.dictamen_2_form_2: Company or organization to which you belong.
privacy.dictamen_2_form_6: Description of the need or project.
privacy.dictamen_2_service_title: When formalizing the provision of a service
privacy.dictamen_2_service_1: RFC (tax ID) and tax address for billing purposes.
privacy.dictamen_2_service_2: Data of the legal representative or authorized contact.
privacy.dictamen_2_service_3: Assigned folio number and economic agreement data.
privacy.dictamen_2_service_4: Technical and operational information of the organization necessary for the execution of the contracted service (e.g., inventory structure, databases, network topology in scope).
privacy.dictamen_2_auto_1: IP address, browser type, operating system, and pages visited, through technical cookies. You can configure or disable cookies from your browser.
privacy.dictamen_3_heading: What your data is used for
privacy.dictamen_3_p1: The technical nature of the Controller's services implies that the information collected has a precise operational purpose. There is no processing without justified purpose.
privacy.dictamen_3_necessary_title: Necessary purposes — without these it is not possible to provide the service
privacy.dictamen_3_necessary_1: Respond to the contact request and determine if there is a need the Controller can address.
privacy.dictamen_3_necessary_2: Prepare proposals, quotes, and service contracts.
privacy.dictamen_3_necessary_3: Execute the contracted project: audits, diagnostics, risk analysis, data structuring, or any other service in the catalog.
privacy.dictamen_3_necessary_4: Manage payment, issue digital tax receipts (CFDI), and comply with accounting obligations.
privacy.dictamen_3_necessary_5: Provide technical follow-up and resolve questions during and after the project.
privacy.dictamen_3_necessary_6: Comply with applicable legal, tax, and regulatory obligations.
privacy.dictamen_3_optional_title: Optional purposes — subject to your decision
privacy.dictamen_3_optional_1: Contact you to follow up on future projects or additional proposals related to services already provided.
privacy.dictamen_3_optional_note: To object to optional purposes, send your request through the channels in Declaration 1.0. Your refusal will not affect the execution of the contracted service.
privacy.dictamen_4_heading: What the Controller does not do with your data
privacy.dictamen_4_p1: In the field of cybersecurity, transparency about what does not happen is as important as declaring what does happen. The Controller commits to the following:
privacy.dictamen_4_1: Does not sell, rent, assign, or commercialize personal data to third parties under any circumstances.
privacy.dictamen_4_2: Does not use technical or operational information provided by the client for purposes other than the execution of the contracted service.
privacy.dictamen_4_3: Does not share findings, reports, or client data with other organizations, competitors, or entities without express authorization.
privacy.dictamen_4_4: Does not transfer data abroad without contractual measures guaranteeing a level of protection equivalent to Mexican law.
privacy.dictamen_4_5: Does not retain files, databases, or diagnostics beyond the time necessary or legally required.
privacy.dictamen_5_heading: When and with whom we share
privacy.dictamen_5_p1: The Controller shares data only with third parties that operationally participate in the provision of the service or whose intervention is required by law:
privacy.dictamen_5_1: External technical specialists who collaborate punctually in the execution of a project, bound by confidentiality agreements prior to accessing any information.
privacy.dictamen_5_2: Digital infrastructure providers (storage, email, work tools), operating as data processors under contract.
privacy.dictamen_5_3: Tax, judicial, or regulatory authorities, exclusively when required by law or by formal order.
privacy.dictamen_5_p2: None of these transfers has commercial purposes. All are backed by contract or legal obligation.
privacy.dictamen_6_p1: In accordance with the LFPDPPP, you have the right to know what data we have (Access), correct inaccuracies (Rectification), request its deletion (Cancellation), and object to specific uses (Objection). To exercise them:
privacy.dictamen_6_1: Send your request to the privacy email hola@datika.com.mx or call us at +52 1 55 1857 7687.
privacy.dictamen_6_2: Include: full name, copy of official identification, and precise description of the right you wish to exercise.
privacy.dictamen_6_3: If acting through a representative, attach the document accrediting the representation.
privacy.dictamen_6_p2: The Controller will respond within a maximum of 20 business days counted from receipt of the complete request. If applicable, the response will be made effective within the following 15 business days.
privacy.dictamen_6_p3: If you consider that your request was not properly addressed, you may file a complaint with the National Institute for Transparency, Access to Information and Personal Data Protection (INAI) at www.inai.org.mx.
privacy.dictamen_7_heading: How long we retain your data
privacy.dictamen_7_p1: Retention periods respond to operational needs and specific legal obligations:
privacy.dictamen_7_1: Billing and contracting data: 5 years, in compliance with the Federal Tax Code.
privacy.dictamen_7_2: Technical files, reports, and project deliverables: up to 90 calendar days after final delivery, unless otherwise agreed with the client.
privacy.dictamen_7_3: Contact data and project-related communications: up to 2 years after the relationship ends.
privacy.dictamen_7_4: Browsing data and cookies: according to the Cookie Policy published on the site.
privacy.dictamen_7_p2: Once these periods expire, data is blocked and subsequently deleted or irreversibly dissociated, in accordance with Article 11 of the LFPDPPP.
privacy.dictamen_8_p1: This notice may be modified to reflect legal, operational, or business changes. Any substantial update will be communicated by email to those who have shared their data with the Controller and will be published on the website with a visible effective date. The current version will always be available on the site.

refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.intro: In technical consulting, the time invested is not always visible from the outside. A cybersecurity report, a feasibility study, or an inventory audit involve hours of analytical work before the Client sees a single page. This policy does not measure the time elapsed since payment: it measures the actual state of the deliverable at the time of the cancellation request. That is the fair criterion for both parties.
refunds.base_p1: The Company classifies the progress of each project into four states. The state of the project at the time of receiving a cancellation request determines the applicable economic treatment. None of these states depends on how many days have elapsed, but on what work has actually been performed.
refunds.base_state_a: State A – Not started: Payment was received but the project has not begun operationally (no kick-off sessions have been held, no accesses or inputs have been requested, no internal team has been assigned).
refunds.base_state_b: State B – Initiation and diagnosis: Initial sessions have been held, Client information has been received, and analytical or field work has begun, but no partial deliverable exists yet.
refunds.base_state_c: State C – Advanced work: Executed and documented work exists: drafts, preliminary findings, partially processed databases, identified vulnerabilities, or drafted report sections.
refunds.base_state_d: State D – Completed deliverable: The report, document, database, or dashboard is complete and ready for delivery, regardless of whether it has been sent to the Client.
refunds.client_p1: The Client may request cancellation of a service at any time, communicating their decision in writing to the contact email available on the site. The payment treatment will depend on the actual state of the project at the time of the request:
refunds.client_1_text: If the project has not formally started, the Company will review the case to determine if a refund is applicable.
refunds.client_1_note: If applicable, the corresponding amount will be returned deducting administrative and operational expenses incurred (brief review, folio generation, bank management, or other related expenses). The refund, if applicable, will be made within 10 business days following written confirmation.
refunds.client_2_title: 1. Project with formal start or work performed.
refunds.client_2_text: If the project has formally started or work has been performed (including analysis, planning, diagnosis, partial development, or operational coordination), no refund will proceed. The project will be considered started when there is any documentable activity linked to the contracted service.
refunds.client_3_text: If the service has been fully provided or the deliverable has been completed, no refund proceeds under any circumstances.
refunds.company_p1: The Company may suspend or cancel a project under the following circumstances:
refunds.company_1: The Client does not provide the necessary inputs, accesses, or information within 20 business days from the request, without reasonable justification.
refunds.company_2: The Client requests that the service be executed on systems, data, or assets for which they do not prove sufficient rights or authorization.
refunds.company_3: The project conditions change substantially from what was quoted and the parties fail to reach a written agreement on the new scope.
refunds.company_p2: The payment treatment will depend on the actual state of the project at the time of cancellation:
refunds.company_1_text: If the project has not formally started, the Company will review the case to determine if a refund is applicable. If applicable, the corresponding amount will be returned deducting administrative and operational expenses incurred up to that moment.
refunds.company_2_title: 2. Project with formal start or work performed.
refunds.company_2_text: If the project has formally started or work has been performed (including analysis, planning, diagnosis, partial development, or operational coordination), no refund will proceed. The project will be considered started when there is any documentable activity linked to the contracted service.
refunds.company_3_text: If the service has been fully provided or the deliverable has been completed, no refund proceeds.
refunds.company_p3: The Company will issue a formal cancellation notification and, if applicable, the corresponding settlement within the following 15 business days.
refunds.mechanism_p1: When a refund is applicable, the Company manages it as follows:
refunds.mechanism_1: The refund will be made through the same payment method used by the Client, unless operational reasons make it impossible, in which case an alternative method will be agreed in writing.
refunds.mechanism_2: The processing period will be 10 to 15 business days counted from the written confirmation of cancellation and the determination of refund applicability.
refunds.mechanism_3: Any expense, financial commission, or administrative charge associated with refund processing will be deducted from the amount to be returned.
refunds.mechanism_p2: To initiate a cancellation or refund request, the Client must send a written message to the contact email available on the site, indicating: name, project folio number, reason for the request, and perceived progress status.
refunds.legal_p1: This policy is an integral part of the Company's Terms and Conditions and is interpreted in accordance with the Federal Consumer Protection Law (LFPC), the Federal Civil Code, and other applicable regulations in the United Mexican States.
refunds.legal_p2: The Client retains at all times their consumer rights before PROFECO (www.profeco.gob.mx) and before the competent courts of Mexico City.
refunds.legal_p3: The Company may modify this policy at any time. Changes apply to projects initiated after the update date. Ongoing projects are governed by the version in effect at the time of their initiation.
